mundane_explanation.surviving: HTTP semantics show client error (invalid vectors) returned as HTTP 200 + 'acknowledged' status instead of HTTP 4xx, indicating Type1_IllegalSuccess. Empty vectors and dimension mismatches are silently rejected at storage layer after acknowledgment, not before. Wait parameter (WaitUntil enum) only controls timing of acknowledgment (WAL vs Visible) but does not affect input validation order. This violates the principle that validation should occur before acknowledgment regardless of wait setting.
